meta.title: The Walk from the Bus Stop
meta.textType: functional: directions on foot with a map

paragraphs: On Friday, December eleventh, Teacher Kim hung a big map on the whiteboard. Then she gave each pair of Explorers a paper copy. The map showed the walk from the bus stop to the science museum. In one corner, there was a box with a key. "We are going to the museum tomorrow," she said. "Please listen to the directions, and follow them on your map." Lily sat with Mia, and Leo sat with May. Everybody wanted to see the whole route.

Teacher Kim read the first part slowly. "Get off the bus at the stop in front of the bank." "Walk straight on, past the police station, the restaurant, and the post office." "Then you pass the apartment building." "At the building site with the sign 'FOR SALE', turn right." Lily followed the words with her pencil. Mia put her finger on the bank. "I found it," she said.

Teacher Kim read the second part. "Walk along the street, and the hotel is on your right." "At the traffic light, go across the street." "The department store is on your left." "The museum is behind it, opposite the river park." She pointed at the museum on the big map.

"How long is the walk?" asked Leo. "About ten minutes," said Teacher Kim, "so it is not far." May looked at the key. "What does the tree mean?" she asked. "The tree is the river park," said Mia. Mia checked each place on the key, one by one. "The B is the bank, and the P is the police station," she said. May read the captions out loud. The caption under the museum said "The Science Museum."

Lily took a red pencil. She drew the route from the bus stop to the museum. Then she wrote the words "ten minutes" next to the museum. Leo traced the red route with his finger. Mia held a green pencil over the key, and May held up her copy. "Now we all know the way," said Lily. "Tomorrow nobody will get lost," said Leo. Teacher Kim smiled and said, "Please put your maps in your bags."
text.summary: Teacher Kim shows the Explorers a map of the walk from the bus stop to the science museum. The children follow the directions, check the key and the captions, and draw the route.
